sections.heading: About APCOER-TBI
sections.content:
- Host Entity
Akhil Bharatiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad’s Anantrao Pawar College of Engineering & Research, Parvati, Pune 411009 started in 2012 having 6 UG, 2 PG, 4 B.Voc. courses and Ph.D Research Centre affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University, Pune. APCOER Technology Business Incubation Centre is develop for developing young entrepreneurs/students/faculties innovative Ideas to successful startups. The institute and Incubation Centre are started by Akhil Bhartiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad, Parvati, Pune 09, an educational trust was founded by a team of renowned educationists and social reformers. The Institute and APCOER TBI are situated in the area of 10 acres of land surrounded by beautiful landscape of Sahyadri Hills of Western Ghat nearing to famous Parvati Hills. Institute is committed to impart quality technical education as per the needs and expectations of all the stakeholders. APCOER, Pune is under the Mentorship of College of Engineering, Pune (COEP). National & International recognized Researchers are involved in the Innovation Club of Institute guiding the faculties and students for Product development, Startups and to become Entrepreneur through Business Incubation Centre. APCOER, Pune is committed to comprehensive development of Students through quality technical education. Institute is nurturing & cultivating innovative ideas/ projects/ patents/ copyrights of students and faculties for developing their own startups through APCOER Technology Business Incubation Centre. The experts from various fields are guiding and sponsoring to built startup Ecosystem. APCOER Innovation Club members are identifying current & future needs of society/ industry and students/ faculties solving it by technical and innovative way to develop to own startups.
- Justification for the selected thrust area:
ABMSP’s APCOER TBI decided to work on “Precision and Smart Agro Engineering Instruments and Equipments”, as already many researchers are working sustainable solution in the field of Agriculture Technology. Currently large number of agri-machinery products are being imported and sold in Indian market. Farmers are still working with traditional methods and instrument which are inefficient and require more efforts. With advancement in technology in the field of artificial intelligence, machine learning, IOT, robotics and data science, there is a wide scope to support the farmers and local industries MSMEs to boost the local economy. Rapidly expanding mechanization of agriculture is creating large scope for new businesses to develop agri machinery and IOT based solutions to farmers. In providing these solutions students, entrepreneurs, start-ups and MSMEs can play a vital role. However, it is required to bring all these stakeholders together to form an innovation ecosystem. Technology business incubator can connect all these stakeholders and helps in boosting the local economy. The proposed incubator would focus on promoting start-ups in this business space and provide support for innovation to meet typical Indian agriculture needs. The institute is surrounded by many industrial clusters MSMEs, viz, Parvati Industrial estate, Katraj MIDC, Dhayari MIDC in the periphery of 15 Km. These MSMEs are contributing in providing local employment which helps to grow the local economy. However, they are facing lot of problems related to innovation ecosystem, facilities, mentoring, skilled manpower, technology transfer services etc. The institute has the potential to address to all these issues and its biggest strength is innovative students, industry connect and faculties. The proposed Technology business incubator can act as an economic development tool to promote growth through innovation, and application of technology. The Institute has very good connect with farmers to understand their problems. Institute is already working on a Agronet project, which aims at giving distance education to farmers. Through collaboration with Sakal Papers, institute is connected with 4 lakh farmers and providing them the solutions using AI-NLP technology through a mobile app. The students and faculties are currently working on many agricultural projects like strawberry crop monitoring, crop disease detection, IOT base project related to measurement of parameters of weather, soil, nutrients, seeds etc. Institute has also developed a drone for remote operated insecticide spray and a polyhouse structure in college premises. Institute has developed a mechanized IOT based greenhouse structure and a Gantry robot on the campus. Focus of the incubator is “Engineering for Agriculture” To develop instruments, equipment for agriculture with the help of local industry to boost the local economy focusing on improving the living standard of framers and supporting the MSMEs to grow their business.
